methodology.isolation: disposable Orchestra home and Chrome profile; every pointer, keyboard, and DOM fallback mode starts with a unique same-artifact Page.navigate loader and authenticates through the real loopback login without browser token persistence
methodology.fixture_transport: board, agents, card, workspace, canonical job/session, profile, conversation, and events created through authenticated public APIs
methodology.failure_artifacts: bounded redacted JSON only; no page HTML, response body, transcript, storage, or screenshot capture
methodology.interaction_readiness: two consecutive 40ms observations; 4000ms interaction bound and 10000ms asynchronous render bound
methodology.performance_quality_link: pointer-only timing is retained separately from pointer quality; a fast failed attempt never becomes a quality pass
methodology.budgets: observation-only: no budget is derived from this run
